scope: Development evaluation of the unchanged public fixed-duel learner in real pinned Showdown; no full G2/G3 or strategic-strength promotion.
primary: For each of the three training seeds, the fixed final checkpoint's score versus random must be >=0.60, its Bonferroni-adjusted pair-bootstrap lower bound >0.55, and the adjusted paired improvement lower bound over that seed's initialization >0. No seed pooling or checkpoint selection.
diagnostics: All checkpoints versus random, damage-greedy and the seed's frozen initial policy; nominal 95% pair-bootstrap intervals. Per-seed critic MSE, clipped Brier, out-of-range rate and ten reliability bins are descriptive only.
pairing: Both seats share the pair's Showdown seed; candidate checkpoints share pair IDs, seed and policy random-key addresses. Diverging paths do not imply identical chance events. One pair is the resampling unit; training seeds are reported separately.
baseline: Random is uniform over two legal moves. Damage-greedy maximizes immediate expected damage under the declared public set: both moves are equal-power, so its frozen tie-break favors higher priority (Quick Attack). Frozen-initial uses the unchanged binary actor at update zero of the same training seed.
stopping: Fixed 2048 updates per seed and all 27 evaluation cells; no early stopping, tuning, selective reruns or final data. Any implementation failure is retained and invalidates that run; a repair requires a new run directory and admission.
final_evaluation: All 128 final teams remain reserved; no final episodes read or generated.
